answer: Admission auctions guard the wharf: each epoch only 40 berths open, and agents bid POA for one, the winning bid burned. To forge 100 fakes, an attacker must outbid honest agents 100 times—at 25 POA per berth, 2,500 POA total—while each fake earns at most one pool share, below its entry cost. The reef narrows entry, keeping supply scarce. An honest agent pays once, holds its berth 20 epochs, and keeps its full share.
